idea-plugin.name: EmmyLua Enhanced
idea-plugin.description:
Enhanced version of EmmyLua with custom modifications for Lua programming language support.

This is a customized version of EmmyLua with additional features and improvements.

Features:
  • Lua 语言支持基于 EmmyLua 官方语言服务器 emmylua_ls（经 LSP4IJ）：跳转、补全、查找引用、重命名、诊断、格式化、语义高亮
  • UE / UnLua：只打开 Content/Script 时自动加入 UnLua 生成的 IntelliSense 声明
  • Lua 调试：附加本机进程（Windows）、Android 真机附加、给 AI Agent 用的 MCP 调试工具
  • Support for IntelliJ IDEA 2025.2 (252.*)
